_format: Charts use an eighth-note grid, 8 symbols per bar. L M R: step on that button (an odd eighth is an off-beat Issohadore call). l m r: hold that button, each following '=' extends it by one eighth. X: bell (tilt), always alternating up and down. > <: rope swipe. -: stand still. .: nothing. first_beat: seconds into the audio file where the chart's first eighth falls.

songs.title: The First Steps
songs.about: Steps on the beat and alternating bells.

songs.title: The Rope
songs.about: Held notes, off-beat Issohadore calls and the rope swipe.
